name: kushconsole
title: KushConsole
description: Kush space, keyboard edition. Saved Messages composer (type = save, @name = send, /word = search) + Fleet cockpit for both machines.
author: example-owner

commands.name: saved
commands.title: Saved Messages
commands.subtitle: KushConsole
commands.description: Bar = composer (↵ saves). @name sends to a person or agent. /query searches. ↵ on a message = edit, ⌃X delete, ⌘C copy.

commands.name: fleet
commands.title: Fleet
commands.subtitle: KushConsole
commands.description: Agents on Mac + server: state, ctx, 5h. ↵ message the bot, ⌘R restart, ⌃X stop, ⌘⇧P park, ⌘⇧N spawn.

preferences.name: tgsPath
preferences.title: tgs binary
preferences.description: Path to the tgs CLI (KushDarbar/tgs). Default ~/bin/tgs.
